name: com.faolline.graphsave
description: Optional persistence layer for the Faolline graph ecosystem: a neutral, serializable GraphRunSnapshot (capture/restore a run's context state + current node over com.faolline.graphcore) and an IGraphSaveStore seam. Bring your own backend, or add the com.faolline.graphsave.savesystem bridge to persist through com.faolline.savesystem.core.
